availability_contract.source: current collaboration transport exact model/effort capability catalog supplied at planning time

routine_mechanical.use_for: bounded repetitive transformations, extraction, and mechanical test plumbing with a complete contract

general_code.use_for: ordinary implementation and targeted tests under a complete, non-scientific contract

orchestrator.use_for: decompose only independent concrete workstreams, assign disjoint ownership, and integrate receipts

subagent_specialist.use_for: bounded implementation or proof subtask with a frozen target and declared owned files

subagent_routine.use_for: read-only mapping, test selection, finite inventory, or other independent routine subtask

review_or_research.use_for: fresh independent review, research synthesis, or high-consequence interpretation; never self-admit

blocker_escalation.use_for: high-difficulty diagnosis after two preserved, same-class substantive failures, or a genuinely high-consequence blocker

escalation.repair_owner: return an authorized bounded repair to the appropriate implementation route; Astra remains read-only
escalation.otherwise: return the exact missing input with HOLD and continue independent READY work
